taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Kor-road, Bori Metropolis. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1916 | 1.24 | 1.24
2 | 1252 | 1.79 | 3.03
3 | 1658 | 108 | 111
4 | 581 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AK-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Kor-road, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Report – Station Kor-road, Bori Metropolis**

The interpreted VES model at Kor-road comprises four layers. Resistivity decreases from 1916 Ω·m (Layer 1) to 1252 Ω·m (Layer 2), then rises to 1658 Ω·m (Layer 3), before dropping to 581 Ω·m (Layer 4). Depths to base are 1.24 m, 3.03 m, and 111 m for Layers 1–3, with Layer 4 unbounded.

Applying the curve-type convention: for Layers 1-2-3 (1916 > 1252 < 1658) the pattern is H; for Layers 2-3-4 (1252 < 1658 > 581) the pattern is K. The resulting curve type is therefore **HK**, not the **AK** type listed in the file. The on-file classification does not match the resistivity sequence and should be corrected before further use in design or correlation work.

{"curve_type_stated": "HK", "label_issue_flagged": true}
